notes.title: v1.1.1 - Final Content Update + Daily Challenge Competition #2
notes.content:
Hey all, we're back with the last content update for Super Raft Boat and a new Daily Challenge Competition! We're happy with where the game is, and want to put our focus towards our other projects. Though this is the last update, keep an eye out for more Super Raft Boat related news coming soon...

Patch Notes

Fish/Trout collisions have been tweaked
Metal Raft can only sustain 10 hits (but regens on loops)
All characters now have 3 max hp
Chauncy's Shotgun deals slightly less damage
Roboto's Minigun deals slightly more damage
Roboto now has a raft building time of 1.5s instead of 2s
Fixed a bug where getting a certain amount of trinkets would crash the game

Think you have what it takes to make it to the top of the leaderboard? This Thursday, you'll have a chance to put your skills to the test for epic prizes!

On June 26th, 2021, the top 5 players on the leaderboard by 11 : 59 : 59 PM  EDT will win Steam Keys for Cloud Bashers DX and Floaty Fighters!

If you want to be eligible, join the Shattered Journal Games Discord. On the day of the competition, once you have completed your Daily Run, post a screenshot of your score in the Discord. The top 5 submissions will be chosen to win the Steam Keys!

If you still haven't seen our official Steam Guide, you can check it out here for tips, tricks, or general information about the game:
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2406492659

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1541250/Super_Raft_Boat/

notes.title: v1.1.0 - The Arctic Ocean Update
notes.content:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iPCsraj-G8I

The Arctic Ocean

Welcome to The Arctic Ocean
The terrain here is brutal, the fish are relentless, and the icebergs never stop coming. If you choose to go the route of The Arctic Ocean, you skip Rough Waters and The Sea of the Damned, and end up in the middle of The Blood Sea. This also yields a Trinket in a bottle whether you've looped or not. Do know that you will get less kills overall if you choose The Arctic Ocean over passing through Rough Waters.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39794612/7c5ee1377b9a1b40e109c41fbd167624c309e168.gif

How do I get there?
On the second wave of Clear Skies, a penguin egg will come from the top of the screen. If you successfully catch the egg and protect it throughout the wave, the egg will hatch. If the penguin is on your raft when you pick a Trinket, you will be brought to The Arctic Ocean. Once you've reached The Arctic Ocean, the penguin will remain on your raft for the rest of your journey for as long as you can protect it :)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39794612/fa1a802b6cff0151d974982c67c45d4bb8c26bfc.gif



Trinkets

Sheet Metal
Turns your center raft into a Metal Raft. This raft can not be destroyed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39794612/646360015ab8662f3f375e2080ee71b0240f68a8.png

Lightning Rod
Lightning will follow you, but will stop a second before it strikes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39794612/98fb214c48ebe51acd144b585b9639a7115ecb27.png

Dice
Rerolls all your current Trinkets (including the Dice) into new Trinkets.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39794612/ba73613349ac56b02f9566269dbe4ff0b1642c8e.png

Net
The Net now has a completely different functionality. Whenever a raft is destroyed, it has a 25% chance of respawning.

Hot Sauce
Hot Sauce now has a 50% chance of firing a 2x damage shot instead of a 12.5% chance.



Stats Screen

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39794612/208dd56b25232341be3b6d0db8d3f7125b5eb9d6.gif

You can now view your stats on the Character Select menu. These stats have been saved since the previous update, so you can jump right in and view your kills, playtime, loops, wins, deaths, and best run for each character!



New Achievements

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39794612/91ffb613dc29e08469382c1ba4672ee22541aa72.png

There are now 3 new achievements to unlock! Try your hand at each one, and you may find them to be worth your while ;)



Keybinding and Controller Options

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39794612/2f239d6d11ac44251225792c98d551a7aeab4145.gif

Keyboard + Mouse players can now remap the movement controls, and Controller players have the option to swap the left and right stick aswell as enable Auto-Fire.



Character Changes

Helveti

Helveti's Machine Gun now deals slightly more damage

Chauncy

Chauncy now has a raft building time of 1.5s instead of 2s
Chauncy now has 1 additional second of breathing time
Chauncy's Shotgun now deals slightly more damage
Chauncy's Slugger now deals more damage
Chauncy's B-Skin is now unlocked by killing 800 sharks as Chauncy across multiple runs

Roboto

Roboto's Minigun now deals more damage
Roboto's Minigun will now increase in fire rate as it's charge gets lower


Additional Changes


Bottles no longer spawn on loops (Unless you're in the Arctic Ocean)
When a bottle doesn't spawn, the game will seamlessly transition to the next area on wave completion.
Plastic Straw now makes fish slower
Plastic Straw causes warning indicators to show earlier
Trinkets now have a visual indicator to show when they've activated.
There are now icons to show where your run ended on the Daily Leaderboard
Enemy spawn rates are more balanced when looping
Adjusted hitboxes of Seagulls, Parrots, and Fish
Adjusted hitboxes of The Kraken
Steam Achievements now unlock immediately
A heck of a lot of bug fixes



Full Patch Notes can be found here: https://pastebin.com/vriwhy07



https://store.steampowered.com/app/1541250/Super_Raft_Boat/

Click here to follow the Discord for future updates!

notes.title: v1.0.3 - Roboto Minigun Overhaul + Daily Leaderboard Update
notes.content:
Hey all. we're back with another update! We've heard complaints about Roboto's Minigun, and we couldn't agree more. So we've overhauled the Minigun completely, with all new stats, and an all new mechanic ːsteamhappyː

The first major change you may notice is that the Minigun's ammo meter is now used as an overheat meter. If you use the Minigun for too long, it will overheat and leave you completely vulnerable for a few seconds. As a result, the minigun now fires twice as fast, with bullets that are roughly half the size. The Minigun is very easy to use for the first couple waves, but as your runs progress, the overwhelming amount of enemies will make mastering the overheating mechanic essential to getting a good score.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39794612/2b0667b06c54c64724b539e4995d96867e14c4bc.gif

Along with this change, we've made a few minor changes to the Daily Leaderboard. First off, you can now scroll up/down the leaderboards with the Scroll Wheel (W and S are still used to scroll in increments of 10).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39794612/09a4c8d4e93f3b4f63461fad65ef02e4598e9d3b.gif

You may also notice a new icon on the leaderboards. If you ended your Daily Run by sitting on the Lawn Chair, you'll have a little Palm Tree icon next to your score, signifying that you decided to end your run on the Island.

If you still haven't seen our official Steam Guide, you can check it out here for tips, tricks, or general information about the game:
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2406492659
We've been seeing a lot of your scores improving over each Daily and we encourage you all to keep trying your hardest. We'll see you at the top ;)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1541250/Super_Raft_Boat/

Click here to follow the Discord for future updates!

notes.title: v1.0.2 - Quality of Life Update + Hotfixes
notes.content:
Hey all! We hope you're enjoying the game so far. We put out an update the other day that fixed a few issues people were having, and today we're releasing a new update that should help point players in the right direction, as well as improving their quality of life.

First off, we've changed the unlock condition for Roboto's B-Skin. It's a little harder now, but is less dependent on RNG.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39794612/26ac0eb8ed007017fde0d66becbe7256cfce7650.png

We've also made lightning show their warning for 2x longer so you have more time to avoid (or to get directly hit by) lightning. This should make the task of unlocking Roboto a lot more lenient.

You may also notice some new visual changes to the Main Menu. Thanks to Yukon we now have birds flying in the distance :0

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39794612/251ed81bb9ce54c386c7713cce25d2eb4b015fef.png

That's all the major changes with this update, there's also a few miscellaneous bug fixes here and there to make sure everything runs smoothly and error-free :)

Finally, we released a Steam Guide that describes the game and it's mechanics in-depth for those who want to know all there is to know, or for those who may need a push in the right direction. You can find that Guide here:
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2406492659
We've been real impressed with some of the Daily scores we've seen so far and we can't wait to see how much y'all improve!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1541250/Super_Raft_Boat/

Click here to follow the Discord for future updates!

notes.content:
